description: This file defines jQuery's queue management functions, including queue, dequeue, clearQueue, and promise, extending jQuery's prototype and internal data handling for queue operations.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Manages the queue of functions or data for a DOM element, allowing to add items to the queue.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Removes and executes the next function in the queue for a DOM element.

methods.name: clearQueue
methods.description: Clears the queue of a specified type for DOM elements.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when the queue of a specified type is emptied.
